```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Certificate renewal automation"

block scheduler "Scheduler"
block renewaljob "Renewal Job"
block caclient "CA Client"
block ca "Certificate Authority"
block deployagent "Deploy Agent"
block service "Service"

edge scheduler -> renewaljob "timer"
edge renewaljob -> caclient "obtain cert"
edge caclient -> ca "request/issue"
edge renewaljob -> deployagent "new cert"
edge deployagent -> service "restart"
```

Notes:
- Six blocks, one per id given, with short human-readable labels.
- Five edges exactly as described: scheduler→renewaljob (timer trigger), renewaljob→caclient (ask to obtain), caclient→ca (talk to the CA), renewaljob→deployagent (hand off once cert is obtained), deployagent→service (restart to pick up new cert).
- Edge labels are kept short per the "labels carry structure, not prose" guidance — the surrounding write-up can carry the fuller narrative if needed.
